text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from examples instead of following strict instructions. In supervised learning, we give the computer a large set of training data. This data includes inputs and their correct answers, like photos of dogs labeled “dog” and photos of cats labeled “cat.” Using this data, the computer builds a model, which is like a rulebook for making decisions. Once the model is trained, it can make predictions on new, unseen inputs. For example, it can look at a new photo and guess whether it shows a dog or a cat. Finally, we check the model’s accuracy by seeing how often its predictions are correct.
